title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.coprime_of_lt_prime
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.coprime_of_lt_prime` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ {n p : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → n < p → Nat.Prime p → p.Coprime n

notes: Proved in Axeyum via `declare_coprime_of_lt_prime` (`nat_prelude/primes.rs`), landed prior to this lane: `g := gcd a p` divides `p` (`gcd_dvd_right`), so primality's divisor clause forces `g = 1 ∨ g = p`; the `g = p` branch transports `g ∣ a` along `g = p` into `p ∣ a`, which with `0 < a` gives `p ≤ a` via `le_of_dvd`, contradicting `a < p`.
